candidates.title: Vortex: Bridging Extreme Compression and Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Recent hardware/system co-design for translating vector quantization and input-dependent sparsity into practical inference efficiency on systolic-array accelerators. Reports 8.03x-23.7x end-to-end speedup and 5.68x-12.5x energy reduction; relevant adjacent architecture/runtime lineage for compressed inference.
